title: National Trust
intro: This lesson fades out words as the audio plays. Click a sentence to jump back to that point.
sentences: The National Trust is a charity organization in the United Kingdom that works to protect important places for future generations.
It was founded in 1895 and now takes care of many historic houses, gardens, forests, beaches, and other natural areas.
The main goal of the National Trust is to preserve the country’s cultural and natural heritage.
It repairs old buildings, protects wildlife, and helps people learn about history and nature.
Many volunteers support its activities by giving their time and skills.
People can visit National Trust properties to enjoy beautiful scenery, learn about local history, and take part in educational programs.
Membership fees and donations help pay for the organization’s work.
The National Trust plays an important role in protecting the environment and historical sites.
Thanks to its efforts, many valuable places can be enjoyed not only today but also by future generations.
It is a good example of how citizens can work together to protect their country’s heritage.
